verdict: MRVL −7–8% on Google deal revenue-timing concerns drags MU/SNDK premarket; HBM memflation decelerating but structurally elevated; NVDA $108B Q3 guide anchors bull thesis; mixed signals across complex.
body_md:
## Fresh Developments (Sep 16–18, 2026)

**MRVL (Marvell) sell-off — key overhang today:** After record Q2 FY2027 results and a landmark $12.2B Google share-purchase deal (Aug 19), MRVL reversed sharply, down ~7–8% in Sep 18 premarket. Catalyst: Google custom-chip revenue not meaningfully hitting until FY2029; gross margin compression from custom ASIC mix. Dragging MU (−1.3%) and SNDK (−1.5%) with it — sentiment contagion, not fundamental shift.

**COHR (Coherent) bounced +6% Sep 16** after −24% over the prior month. Record AI photonics bookings extending through calendar 2028; valuation overhang persists.

**HBM capacity surge confirmed (Sep 12):** Micron doubling HBM wafer starts to ~100K/month by year-end; 12-high HBM4 rising to ~50% of Micron HBM output. Samsung targeting ~250K wafers/month (+50%) and HBM4 >60% of HBM mix in H2 2026. All three suppliers ramping simultaneously — the baseline "correction after 2026" risk is accumulating.

**ZS (Zscaler) −17%:** Small revenue miss ($850.5M vs. $860.4M est.) produced an outsized reaction — reflects stretched software valuations.

**SNOW (Snowflake) large beat Sep 2:** EPS $0.62 vs. $0.26 est. (+138%); simultaneous AWS deal announced.

---

## Watchlist Movers

| Name | Move | Catalyst |
|------|------|----------|
| MRVL | −7–8% premarket Sep 18 | Google deal revenue delayed to FY2029; margin compression from ASIC mix |
| MU | −1.3% premarket Sep 18 | MRVL sentiment contagion; India fab start ($2.75B) failed to hold gains |
| SNDK | −1.5% premarket Sep 18 | Same MRVL overhang; YTD still +648% |
| COHR | +6% Sep 16 | Technical bounce; record AI photonics bookings through 2028 intact |
| ZS | −17% (Sep 3) | Small revenue miss vs. estimate — valuation reset |
| SNOW | Large gain (Sep 2) | EPS +138% beat; simultaneous AWS deal |
| NOW | +28% past month | AI-agent (Agentforce) monetization narrative |
| AMPX | Positive | Record Q2 rev $34M; raised FY2026 guide to ≥$140M |
| TSLA | −6% Sep 4 | Cybercab update "underwhelmed" Wall Street; partial recovery since |

No notable fresh catalysts on: RMBS, STX, GDDY, NOK, AMD, AVGO, ALAB, CRDO, LITE, CIEN (recovering post-Sep-3 beat), FSLR, ENPH, NXT, ARRY, HIVE, CRM, ALMU.

---

## Context vs. Baseline

**Memflation decelerating:** DRAM QoQ: +93–98% Q1 → +58–63% Q2 → +13–18% Q3 (forecast). Pace peak is behind us; prices remain at extremes. HBM spot ~$2,100 (36GB module) vs. $300–400 LTA — all 2026 allocation sold out. 2027 correction risk is the key watch: triple-supplier capacity surge now fully underway.

**Hyperscaler capex revised up:** Combined top-4 now ~$725B vs. baseline $600–700B — no deceleration signal. AWS confirmed 2M NVIDIA GPU purchase; NVDA guided Q3 at $108B ±2%.

**Custom ASIC:** MRVL-Google $120B through FY2033 is the largest single custom-ASIC commitment disclosed this year; near-term revenue gap is the new timing risk embedded in MRVL's valuation.

**Solar:** Aug 6 Section 232 tariff (15% + MIPs on polysilicon/modules/cells) effective Dec 4 — structural positive for FSLR (domestic manufacturer), mixed for ENPH.

---

## Signals Flashing

| Signal | Direction | Bull/Bear |
|--------|-----------|-----------|
| DRAM memflation pace | Decelerating (peak behind us) | Neutral → mild bear |
| HBM supply tightness | Sold out 2026; triple ramp underway | Bull near-term / 2027 correction risk building |
| Hyperscaler AI capex | Revised up to ~$725B | Bull |
| Custom ASIC share shift | Accelerating — MRVL-Google $120B deal | Bull LT; near-term timing/margin headwind |
| Optical demand | Record bookings; transceiver supply constrained | Bull |
| Solar tariffs | 15% + MIPs signed, effective Dec 4 | Bull FSLR; mixed ENPH |
| Semi sentiment (Sep 18) | MRVL overhang weighing on complex | Near-term bear |

---

## Most Important Development

**MRVL −7–8% today** is the pivotal move this week. The largest disclosed custom-ASIC revenue deal in history ($120B MRVL-Google through FY2033) has the bulk of its revenue in FY2029+, reminding the market that AI infrastructure monetization timelines are long. The contagion to MU and SNDK is sentiment-driven, not fundamental — HBM demand is unbroken. The key question: does NVDA's $108B Q3 guide hold the broader semiconductor bid into quarter-end.
